data.name: RedCensor
data.shortDescription: Censor the stuff youtube doesn't like (and more).
data.description:
# Red Censor


A mod to censor various parts of the game.
Currently it can do the following:


- Cover up nipples with custom images
- Disable blood splashes
- Disable blood textures
- Disable dismemberment
- Disable various gore objects around the world (currently very limited)
- Stop enemies from exploding
- Stop the worm (John2) from spawning.
- Disable spiders (crawling under rocks and on webs)

You can configure some parts of the nipple censoring by pressing `Shift + [Configured key]` in-game. Pressing `[Configured key]` allows you to toggle the nipple censoring.

If you want to change the censoring image put a `cenor.png` or `censor.jpg` in the `steamapps\common\Sons Of The Forest\Mods\RedCensor` folder.
